item.title: Glide Popper
item.excerpt:
Popper 16cm-100g
A 16cm-100g popper with a similar shape to the wide-mouthed pop130 and pop150 models, this popper100’s mouth has been designed to produce a loud sound with little effort thanks to a shallow, wide mouth.
Its size and weight make it easy to cast for hours and have already replaced the old cone-shaped model on several fishing trips.

Popper 18cm-130g
It has a good diameter of the mouth, it’s a popper that make big pops but with a slightly more contained weight if compared to the 150g.
The body has a great buoyancy and a lot of resin to have greater strength and minimize damage from the bites of large predators.

Popper 20cm-150g
The new version of the old 180.
The body has a great buoyancy and a lot of resin to have greater strength and minimize damage from the bites of large predators.

nextItem.title: Glide Popper 18cm - 75g
nextItem.excerpt: 18 cm and 75g of weight. It is a small mouth popper that you can retrieve quickly with repeated splashes but if necessary make a nice sound if moved with traditional action on the spot. I designed this popper thinking about rooster or big leerfish or gt that in places with a lot of pressure react badly to the deep bursts of some poppers. obviously it has a weight and a measure that is perfect for tuna. enjoy!
